speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any burning, urgency, or frequency when you urinate? Also, has your fever spiked above 101°F, and do you have any nausea or vomiting?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: It is concerning that your symptoms persisted despite antibiotic treatment for sinusitis, suggesting a possible secondary infection or a different primary issue. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis_and_Urine_Culture
